segments.text_original:
BREAKING: "There was NO basis for CM Chandrababu Naidu to claim that animal fat was used in the Tirupati prasad" What the Supreme Court said on the Tirupati Prasad controversy:
💠SC: On basis of what material did the CM come to a conclusion that animal fat was being used in the prasad? Lab reports are not at all clear...
💠SC: CM got the report in July, investigation was ordered already. What was the need for him to go to the press before knowing the outcome of the investigation?
💠SC: Unless the govt was sure, why did the CM go to the public with these allegations? What was the purpose of the investigation in such a case?
💠SC: Reports prima facie indicate that the ghee which was not found in conformity was NOT used in the prasad.
💠SC: There was no need for the CM to go to the press, Religious sentiments of the devotees need to be respected.
💠SC: Where is the proof that adulterated ghee was used in the preparation of the laddoos?
💠SC: Prima facie, there is no proof to say adulterated ghee was used in making the prasad.
💠SC: There was no basis for the CM to make the statement that animal fat was being used in the prasad.
💠SC: Persons in constitutional posts should make public statements with some responsibility.
